name: Queen's Chamber
description: The queen's opulent private chamber filled with ancient treasures, silk curtains, and luxurious furnishings. A place of absolute power and hidden vulnerability where the queen summons her favored attendant.

spots.name: Chamber
spots.description: An extravagant royal chamber decorated with golden ornaments, silk drapes, plush cushions, and a magnificent bed. Rich incense fills the air, and soft light from ornate lamps creates an intimate atmosphere. The perfect setting for the queen's private moments with her chosen servant.
